tagline: 29 offline PDF tools behind a friendly Home — merge, split, compress, convert, protect, watermark
description: PDF Toolkit puts every everyday PDF job one click away: a searchable Home launcher with the popular tools up front (merge, split, compress, images to PDF, text extraction, AES-256 protect) and the full set — rotate, reorder, extract or delete pages, PDF to images, watermarks, page numbers, headers and footers, metadata, bookmarks, redact, compare, repair, and batch runs — organized into five simple categories. Recent files stay on Home for quick access. Fully offline: your documents never leave your computer. Follows your OS light/dark theme live, with a Ctrl+, Settings dialog. 100% AI-built and open source.
